title: GH Real Estate Canonical Zoho Sign Recipient Policy
scope: All GH Real Estate contract documents sent from Zoho Contracts to Zoho Sign

R1.required_when: A tenant or primary counterparty must sign

R2.required_when: A second tenant or counterparty signer exists

R3.required_when: A third tenant or counterparty signer exists

R4.canonical_role: GH Real Estate, LLC Authorized Representative
R4.required_when: GH Real Estate is a signing party

R5_plus.canonical_role: Additional non-landlord signer roles, including guarantors, witnesses, or approved program-specific signers
R5_plus.required_when: The governed document manifest requires the additional signer

signing_order_policy.rule: Recipient numbers identify field ownership and do not by themselves control routing order. Configure signing positions separately so every tenant, guarantor, and other required non-landlord signer completes signing before GH Real Estate.
signing_order_policy.landlord_last_gate: Do not send unless R4 is the final signing position and no signer is scheduled after R4.

optional_signer_policy.rule: Optional people are omitted entirely; an actual named signer is never given an optional signature field.
optional_signer_policy.tenant_2_absent: Remove the R2 recipient, all R2 tags, and the Tenant 2 signature row.
optional_signer_policy.tenant_3_absent: Remove the R3 recipient, all R3 tags, and the Tenant 3 signature row.
optional_signer_policy.additional_signer_absent: Remove the applicable R5+ recipient, tags, and signature block.

validation_rules: Every signing document must declare a recipient manifest.
R4 is reserved for GH Real Estate, LLC's authorized representative in every GH contract document where GH signs.
R4 must be routed after all other required signers.
No signer may be routed after R4.
Do not renumber GH Real Estate based on the number of tenants.
Do not use padded tags or formatted sign-date tags unless separately approved by the active text-tag registry and required smoke tests.
Use only production-safe simple tags unless the active registry expressly approves another syntax.

exceptions.rule: Any exception requires an explicit repository change, documented rationale, validation updates, and approval before live use.
exceptions.single_party_internal_document: A document not signed by GH Real Estate is outside the R4 landlord requirement but still requires a manifest.
